description: Search live Jobberman job listings with keyword, location, industry, job function, work type and experience filters, replay Jobberman search URLs, or fetch specific listing URLs.

containsKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to the title, company, summary and full description.
containsKeyword.title: Must contain keyword

employmentType.description: Keep only records whose normalised employment type matches. Applied after fetching, so unknown values are never dropped.
employmentType.title: Employment type (post-filter)

experienceLevel.description: Restrict results to a Jobberman experience band.
experienceLevel.title: Experience level

includeFullDescription.description: Open each listing page for the full description, exact dates, salary, requirements, company logo and badges. Turn off for faster card-only records.
includeFullDescription.title: Fetch full job details

industry.description: Restrict results to an employer industry, for example IT & Telecoms or Banking, Finance & Insurance.
industry.title: Industry

jobFunction.description: Restrict results to a job family, for example Software & Data or Sales.
jobFunction.title: Job function

listingUrls.description: Direct Jobberman listing URLs, for example https://www.jobberman.com/listings/account-assistant-8mnppx. Used by the Fetch specific job URLs mode.
listingUrls.title: Job listing URLs

location.description: Restrict results to a Nigerian state, region, remote jobs or jobs outside Nigeria. Use the slug values from the list; legacy `where` inputs may still send a display name.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of jobs pushed to the dataset.
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs

maxPages.description: Safety cap on pages fetched per search source. 0 chooses an automatic cap based on Maximum jobs.
maxPages.title: Maximum search pages

maxSalary.description: Drop jobs whose disclosed salary band is entirely above this value. Jobs with no disclosed salary always pass through.
maxSalary.title: Maximum salary (NGN per month)

minSalary.description: Drop jobs whose disclosed salary band is entirely below this value. Jobs with no disclosed salary always pass through.
minSalary.title: Minimum salary (NGN per month)

mode.description: Choose what to scrape: a keyword/filter search, a list of pasted Jobberman search URLs, or a list of specific job-listing URLs.
enumTitles: Search jobs by keyword and filters
mode.title: Mode

postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means any date. Jobs with no date shown always pass through.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)

searchQueries.description: Run several keyword searches in one run. Each query is deduplicated against the others; useful for broad market coverage.
searchQueries.title: Additional keywords

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword such as a job title, skill or company name. Leave empty to browse every live listing. Legacy inputs using `query`, `keyword` or `keywords` are accepted.
searchQuery.title: Search keyword

searchUrls.description: Paste filtered Jobberman search or category URLs, for example https://www.jobberman.com/jobs/software-data/lagos or https://www.jobberman.com/jobs?q=accountant&sort=popular. Each URL is replayed with pagination.
searchUrls.title: Jobberman search URLs

sortBy.description: Jobberman's own Latest, Featured or Popular order. Sorting is passed to the site and preserved across pagination.
sortBy.title: Sort order

workType.description: Restrict results to the site's own work-type groups: full time, part time, contract and temporary, internship and volunteer, or casual and seasonal.
workType.title: Work type

title: Jobberman Nigeria Job Market Scraper Input
